desc:
• CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious, moist angel food cake dessert

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just add one simple ingredient, bake and enjoy

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes by using as cupcake mix or trying tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

  • DELICIOUS & SPONGY: Enjoy the sweetness of this versatile cake mix and make it your own

  • CONTAINS: 16.75 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features

Fluffy Angel Food Cake Texture
Delivers a classic angel food cake that’s light, airy, and sponge-like.

Colorful Confetti Sprinkles Inside
Baked-in rainbow confetti adds fun and color to every slice—no decorating required.

Just Add Water
Super simple prep—no eggs, oil, or butter needed. Just mix with water and bake.

Fat-Free Dessert Option
Contains zero grams of fat, making it a lighter choice for those watching their diet.

16.75 oz Box
Makes one large cake or multiple smaller servings—perfect for parties, celebrations, or everyday enjoyment.

No Artificial Flavors or Preservatives
Clean and straightforward ingredients with no unnecessary additives.

Kosher Certified
Suitable for a wide range of dietary needs.

Box Tops for Education Eligible
Contributes to school funding through the Box Tops program.

Benefits

Festive Look with Minimal Effort
The built-in colorful confetti makes it party-ready right out of the oven.

Healthier Sweet Option
Light, fluffy, and fat-free—ideal for guilt-free indulgence.

Beginner-Friendly Baking
Simple instructions and no extra ingredients make it perfect for all skill levels.

Perfect for Any Occasion
Great for birthdays, holidays, classroom parties, or just a fun family dessert night.

Customizable
Enjoy as-is or top with whipped cream, fruit, or glaze for an elevated presentation.

Consistent Results
Rises beautifully and slices cleanly—reliable every time.
ingredients: Sugar, Wheat Flour Bleached, Egg White, Corn Starch, Baking Soda, Citric Acid, Corn Syrup, Corn Cereal, Calcium Phosphate, Salt, Palm Oil, Cellulose Gum, Artificial Flavor, Color (yellows 5 & 6, red 40, blue 1), Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (a whipping aid).
